categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in industrial-grade additive manufacturing equipment, focusing on metal (Selective Laser Melting, SLM) and polymer (Selective Laser Sintering, SLS) 3D printing devices. It also provides 3D printing materials, software, processes, and related services. The product portfolio includes over 20 models of 3D printing equipment and more than 40 specialized materials and processes, serving industries such as aerospace, automotive, medical, and mold manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include SLM for metal 3D printing and SLS for polymer 3D printing, with proprietary software and control systems fully developed in-house. The company has developed multi-laser high-precision optical systems, high-precision motion control, uniform and stable airflow systems, and high-precision multi-zone thermal field control. It also innovates in powder handling automation, multi-laser interaction, and high-temperature sintering technologies, including Flight technology using fiber lasers for polymer sintering.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are industrial clients in aerospace, automotive, medical, mold manufacturing, education, and research institutions. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a strong presence in China and exports to over 30 countries. Major end markets include high-end manufacturing sectors requiring complex, high-precision, and large-scale additive manufacturing solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Changsha, Hunan Province. It has established subsidiaries in the United States (Austin, Texas) and Germany (Stuttgart) to support international sales, technical support, and after-sales services. Its global sales and service network covers more than 30 countries and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the additive manufacturing supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and production of 3D printing equipment, materials, and software. It procures key components such as lasers and galvanometers from international suppliers but manufactures most other parts domestically. It also provides downstream services including technical support and customized solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in additive manufacturing equipment, materials, software, and processes to enhance efficiency, precision, and scalability. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on multi-laser systems, large-format printing, high-temperature sintering, automation, and intelligent manufacturing. It aims to achieve full localization of core components and expand applications in emerging fields like low-altitude economy and aerospace. The R&D approach integrates equipment, materials, software, and application development with a strong emphasis on intellectual property and industry standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of 3D printing equipment (metal and polymer), 3D printing materials, and related after-sales services. The company uses a combination of direct sales and distribution channels domestically and internationally. It also earns income from government subsidies and financial investments, but the core business revenue comes from product sales and service contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic industrial-grade additive manufacturing equipment provider in China and ranks among the top globally in sales scale. It competes with international giants like EOS, HP, and SLM Solutions. The company differentiates itself through full in-house development of equipment, software, and materials, and by offering open, customizable systems with strong intellectual property protection. It is recognized as a national 'specialized and innovative' enterprise and a key player in China's additive manufacturing industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 606 million, a 32.74% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 131 million, up 32.26%. The company has a total asset base exceeding RMB 2.3 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of nearly RMB 1.93 billion, reflecting rapid growth fueled by its successful IPO on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market in April 2023. R&D investment accounts for 13.59% of revenue, underscoring its growth driven by innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a comprehensive, fully autonomous additive manufacturing ecosystem integrating equipment, software, and materials with proprietary intellectual property. Its products feature high precision, large build volumes, multi-laser configurations, and advanced process controls, enabling complex and large-scale industrial applications. The open and customizable software platform allows clients to optimize parameters and integrate third-party materials, reducing barriers and costs. The company emphasizes reliability, efficiency, and scalability, supporting industrial-scale production and fostering innovation in emerging sectors such as aerospace and low-altitude economy.
